1.2 Functions


Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave) {
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave) {
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}


# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# Suicidality (wave-specific only, as defined in suicide_specs)
summarise_suicide <- function(df) {
  out_wave <- suicide_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "w3",
      n1 = map2_dbl(cols, rule, ~{
        cols <- .x[.x %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), .y), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime, # or define a w3-specific denominator if you prefer
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out_lifetime <- out_wave %>%
    mutate(wave = "lifetime")  # same because only w3 exists in your example

  bind_rows(out_wave, out_lifetime)
}

title: Tables
text:
Brazilian High-Risk Cohort for Mental Health Conditions
  BHRC





Author: Lucas Toshio Ito
lucas.toshio.ito@gmail.com
lucas.toshio@unifesp.br
Universidade Federal de São Paulo (UNIFESP)
Last updated: March 14, 2026
To contextualize downstream biological analyses, we first summarize the distribution of psychiatric phenotypes across assessment waves in the Brazilian High-Risk Cohort for Mental Health Conditions (BHRC). Diagnoses were derived from the Development and Well-Being Assessment (DAWBA) according to DSM-IV criteria. Suicidality measures were derived from the Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS). The tables below present both wave-specific prevalence and cumulative lifetime prevalence among probands in the cohort.
Because the BHRC is a longitudinal study with repeated assessments, cumulative tables reflect the first occurrence of each disorder across waves, allowing estimation of lifetime prevalence up to the most recent follow-up. This phenotypic characterization provides a reference framework for subsequent analyses integrating multiple biological data layers, including genotyping, neuroimaging, DNA methylation, miRNA expression, RNA sequencing, and whole-genome sequencing (WGS), in which these psychiatric outcomes are used as primary phenotypes.
For anxiety disorders, we combined panic disorder, agoraphobia, generalized anxiety disorder, social phobia, and specific phobias. Suicidal ideation was defined as endorsement of either “Did you want to be dead or wished you could go to sleep and never wake up?” or “Have you actually had thoughts of killing yourself?”. Suicide attempt was defined based on reports of aborted, interrupted, or actual suicide attempts.

Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave) {
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave) {
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)

      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

Author: Lucas Toshio Ito

Last updated: March 14, 2026
To contextualize downstream biological analyses, we summarize the distribution of psychiatric phenotypes across assessment waves in the Brazilian High-Risk Cohort for Mental Health Conditions (BHRC). Diagnoses were derived from the Development and Well-Being Assessment (DAWBA) using DSM-IV criteria, and suicidality measures were obtained from the Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS). Because the BHRC includes repeated assessments, cumulative tables capture the first occurrence of each disorder across waves, providing an estimate of lifetime prevalence up to the most recent follow-up.
These summaries serve as a reference framework for subsequent analyses integrating multiple biological data, including genotyping/ PRS, neuroimaging, DNA methylation, miRNA expression, RNA sequencing, and whole-genome sequencing (WGS). The following tables present wave-specific and cumulative lifetime prevalence among probands.
Anxiety disorders include panic disorder, agoraphobia, generalized anxiety disorder, social phobia, and specific phobias. Suicidal ideation was defined as endorsement of either “Did you want to be dead or wished you could go to sleep and never wake up?” or “Have you actually had thoughts of killing yourself?”, while suicide attempts were defined based on reports of aborted, interrupted, or actual attempts.
Phenotype definitions (DAWBA variables):

Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD): dcanyhk

Anxiety Disorder: dcpanic; dcagor; dcgena; dcsoph; dcspph

Bipolar Disorder / Mania: dcmania

Eating Disorder: dceat

Major Depressive Disorder (MDD): dcmadep

Obsessive–Compulsive Disorder (OCD): dcocd

Psychosis: dcpsych

Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD): dcptsd

Any Psychiatric Disorder: dcany

Suicidality variables (C-SSRS):

Suicidal Ideation (SI): p_colbi1_lt, p_colbi2_lt

Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave) {
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave) {
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

8.2 Functions


Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

3.2 Functions


Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

4.2 Functions


Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

Code# Function to evaluate a rule string like "==2" or ">=2"
eval_rule <- function(x, rule) {
  if (rule == "==2") return(x == 2)
  if (rule == "==1") return(x == 1)
  if (rule == ">=2") return(x >= 2)
  stop("Unknown rule: ", rule)
}

# Wave-specific summary for DAWBA-style phenos (one column per wave)
summarise_wave <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # N for that wave = people with ANY non-missing DAWBA variable for that wave
  # (you can change this denominator definition if you have a better "wave completed" flag)
  wave_cols <- paste0(wave, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>% pull(N)

  # Count cases for each phenotype (using only that wave’s column)
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      colname = paste0(wave, "_", base),
      n1 = map2_dbl(colname, rule, ~{
        if (!.x %in% names(df)) return(NA_real_)
        sum(eval_rule(df[[.x]], .y), na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

summarise_wave_cumulative <- function(df, wave, prefix) {
  column <- paste(prefix, wave, sep="_")
  df <- df[df[[column]] == 1 & !is.na(df[[column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  # all waves up to the current one
  wave_num <- as.numeric(sub("^w", "", wave))
  waves_up_to <- paste0("w", 0:wave_num)
  
  # columns from all waves up to current wave
  wave_cols <- unlist(lapply(waves_up_to, function(w) {
    paste0(w, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  }))
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(df)]
  
  # cumulative N = people with any non-missing value in any phenotype column up to that wave
  N_wave <- df %>%
    transmute(any_obs = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(wave_cols)))) > 0) %>%
    summarise(N = sum(any_obs)) %>%
    pull(N)

  # cumulative count for each phenotype:
  # case if positive in at least one wave up to current wave
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = wave,
      n1 = purrr::map2_dbl(base, rule, ~{
        cols_this_pheno <- paste0(waves_up_to, "_", .x)
        cols_this_pheno <- cols_this_pheno[cols_this_pheno %in% names(df)]
        
        if (length(cols_this_pheno) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        vals <- sapply(cols_this_pheno, function(cl) eval_rule(df[[cl]], .y))
        
        # if only one column, sapply may simplify to vector
        if (is.null(dim(vals))) {
          vals <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1)
        }
        
        sum(rowSums(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      N = N_wave,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

  out
}

# lifetime "ever across waves" for those same phenos
summarise_lifetime_ever <- function(df) {
  out <- pheno_specs %>%
    mutate(
      wave = "lifetime",
      n1 = pmap_dbl(list(base, rule), \(base, rule) {
        cols <- paste0(waves, "_", base)
        cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
        if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        mat <- as.data.frame(df[, cols, drop=FALSE])
        # coerce to numeric if factors
        mat[] <- lapply(mat, \(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(z))))
        sum(rowSums(eval_rule(as.matrix(mat), rule), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      }),
      N = N_lifetime,
      pct = 100 * n1 / N,
      cell = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n1, pct)
    ) %>%
    select(label, wave, cell)

1.5 Wave-specific Psychiatric Phenotypes


Code# waves present
waves <- c("w0","w1","w2","w3")

# For each phenotype, list the "base" column name (without w0_/w1_ prefix)
# and the rule for a positive case.
pheno_specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pheno,      ~label,                 ~base,          ~rule,
  "ADHD",      "ADHD",                 "dcanyhk",      "==2",
  "ANX",       "Anxiety Disorder",     "dcanyanx_pgc", "==2",
  "BD",        "Bipolar/Mania",        "dcmania",      "==2",
  "EAT",       "Eating Disorder",      "dceat",        ">=2",
  "MDD",       "Major Depression",     "dcmadep",      "==2",
  "OCD",       "OCD",                  "dcocd",        "==2",
  "PSY",       "Psychosis",            "dcpsych",      "==2",
  "PTSD",      "PTSD",                 "dcptsd",       "==2",
  "ANY",       "Any Psychiatric Disorder","dcany",     "==2",
  "SI",        "Suicidal Ideation",    "colb_si",      "==2",
  "SA",        "Suicide Attempt",      "colb_sa",      "==2"
)

N_lifetime <- n_distinct(junto_lifetime$subjectid)

long_tbl <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(waves, ~summarise_wave(junto_lifetime, .x)),
  summarise_lifetime_ever(junto_lifetime),
)

# Make pretty column headers with N’s
# Here I’m computing N’s again so headers show denominators.
N_by_wave <- map_int(waves, ~{
  wave_cols <- paste0(.x, "_", pheno_specs$base)
  wave_cols <- wave_cols[wave_cols %in% names(junto_lifetime)]
  sum(rowSums(!is.na(junto_lifetime[, wave_cols, drop=FALSE])) > 0)
})
names(N_by_wave) <- waves

col_names <- c(
  paste0("Wave 0 (N=", N_by_wave["w0"], ")"),
  paste0("Wave 1 (N=", N_by_wave["w1"], ")"),
  paste0("Wave 2 (N=", N_by_wave["w2"], ")"),
  paste0("Wave 3 (N=", N_by_wave["w3"], ")"),
  paste0("Lifetime (N=", N_lifetime, ")")
)

wide_tbl <- long_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    wave_pretty = recode(wave,
                         w0 = col_names[1],
                         w1 = col_names[2],
                         w2 = col_names[3],
                         w3 = col_names[4],
                         lifetime = col_names[5])
  ) %>%
  select(`Psychiatric Phenotype` = label, wave_pretty, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = wave_pretty, values_from = cell)
